title: Kavi model-first developmental curriculum
ordering_policy: Stages are listed in a valid prerequisite order. A runnable stage can begin only when every listed earlier stage is complete; a waiting stage is a hard stop, never a license to skip ahead. Independent future language lanes are serialized on this device unless a separate measured budget authorizes another schedule.
bootstrap_note: The ASCII glyph stage remains a deliberately narrow source-free bootstrap. The next two generated stages preserve single Unicode scalars and test eleven bounded script-oriented prototype lanes; neither proves multilingual or language capability.

stages.title: Generated lowercase ASCII letters and decimal digits
Generated quantities, addition before subtraction, and exact checks
Exact one-scalar Unicode preservation and explicit metadata
Generated script-balanced glyph pathways and confusable-character checks
Language-specific words, definitions, and compositional structure
stages.waiting_reason: The current core has no text representation, word-composition path, language-specific evaluator, or qualified-language review process. Build and validate those before this stage can run.

stages.title: Definitions, formal logic, counterexamples, and checked proofs
stages.waiting_reason: Kavi needs typed symbolic language and an external formal verifier before it may learn or claim a proof skill.

stages.title: Original-language works and carefully licensed textbooks
stages.waiting_reason: The catalog is a prerequisite-aware access list, not a training license. Admit each exact edition or witness, extract, language lane, lesson, verifier, and held-out test only after review.
